Auto-save for distribution files has been removed.
Distribution files are now only saved when you explicitly click Save. A rotating backup is created automatically before each save, stored in: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Boutique\Backups\
This change prevents the silent data loss some users experienced with auto-save.
